args.destination: workspace-relative (or absolute path when the user enabled absolute-path permission) destination path (required)

file.move.target: workspace-relative (or absolute path when the user enabled absolute-path permission) source path (required)

1-30 objects with character_id and declared first physical location

args.slides: optional array of {title, bullets|body, notes, chart, table, image}
